description: 2018-2019 PV Generation of a Rooftop Plant in the University of Macau and Weather Report is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yiwei Qiu, Zhipeng Zhou (Tsinghua University). Solar power geneartion from 2018 to 2019 at a 3kW rooftop pv plant in the university of macau, with a resolation of 30 s, and the public weather report of Macau with a resolution of 1 hour. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
